correctness.rationale: The collapse equivalence follows directly from the definitions in both directions. Published connectedness results cover the stated classical spaces, so exponential spectrum equals ordinary spectrum there and Jacobson's ordinary spectral identity gives exponential-spectral commutativity away from zero.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The connected-invertibles implication is explicitly older and is not claimed new. Searches found no prior application of the classical and recent general-linear-group connectedness results to Horvath--Kania Question 9.2 covering the stated standard families and contrasts.

value.rationale: The result gives a structural no-twisting criterion, closes the canonical c0, ell-p, C[0,1], and L-p[0,1] branches of a newly posed open problem, extends immediately to several modern Bochner/Besov classes, and separates connectedness from stable-rank mechanisms.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
